title: Your home base keeps working while your phone is locked
detail: Ask Jarvis to research something in the background, or to tell you when something happens (a price drop, say). Your iPhone gets a notification when it is ready.

title: A morning briefing at 7:00
detail: The weather, a few headlines and how the home base did overnight, on the Alienware's screen and your iPhone. Say "brief me" any time; change the time or the place in Jarvis, Settings, Home base.

title: Your devices stay in sync
detail: Each device's Jarvis backup is kept on the home base, and your other devices pick up the conversations they are missing. Nothing is ever deleted.

title: Better hearing and George's voice from the home base (beta)
detail: Turn them on in Jarvis, Settings, Home base, Hearing and voice. Whisper on the Alienware hears you, and George's voice comes from the Alienware. Free: it all runs on your own computer.
